title: Why Your Tongue Gets Stuck to a Popsicle
caption:
Lick a popsicle and your tongue can truly stick
In the video he licks an icy popsicle, his tongue freezes to it, snowflakes burst and a panel zooms in on the stuck tongue.
This is flash-freeze adhesion: the popsicle's surface is far colder than your tongue, so your saliva freezes into a thin ice seal that glues your tongue to the ice.
Have you ever panicked with your tongue stuck to ice, and what did you do?
Save this before your next popsicle, and follow for more everyday body science.
